tools.name: nanonets_predict_url
tools.description: Run a Nanonets OCR model on one public https file and return the predicted fields and tables per page. Sync mode: use for files of 3 pages or fewer. Uses account credits. Nanonets: POST /api/v2/OCR/Model/{model_id}/LabelUrls/.

tools.name: nanonets_predict_url_async
tools.description: Queue one public https file for OCR extraction in async mode. Use it for files over 3 pages. Returns a request_file_id; read the result later with nanonets_get_file_predictions. Uses account credits. Nanonets: POST /api/v2/OCR/Model/{model_id}/LabelUrls/?async=true.

tools.name: nanonets_list_predictions
tools.description: List the page-level predictions a model made over a date range (UTC, both days included). Shows approved and unapproved pages. Read only. Nanonets: GET /api/v2/Inferences/Model/{model_id}/ImageLevelInferences.

tools.name: nanonets_get_file_predictions
tools.description: Get the initial model prediction, any reviewer changes, and the final result for one file, by request_file_id (from an upload or from nanonets_list_predictions). Read only. Nanonets: GET /api/v2/Inferences/Model/{model_id}/InferenceRequestFiles/GetPredictions/{request_file_id}.

tools.name: nanonets_get_page_prediction
tools.description: Get the prediction for one page by its page id: the initial prediction, changes, and the final values with their boxes and scores. Read only. Nanonets: GET /api/v2/Inferences/Model/{model_id}/ImageLevelInferences/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nanonets_predict_url_async · Private data: nanonets_predict_url, nanonets_predict_url_async, nanonets_get_file_predictions · Public sink: nanonets_predict_url, nanonets_predict_url_async, nanonets_get_file_predictions · Destructive: nanonets_predict_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nanonets_predict_url_async · Private data: nanonets_predict_url, nanonets_predict_url_async, nanonets_get_file_predictions · Public sink: nanonets_predict_url, nanonets_predict_url_async, nanonets_get_file_predictions · Destructive: nanonets_predict_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
